sentences.text:
---------
 th 09/Dated: 10 September, 2024 1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The description of land is as follows :-
"Village - Marafari, Thana - Balidih, Khata No.23, Plot No.4807, Area - 1 and  decimal."
3. It has been claimed by the petitioner that she is the right title holder of the aforesaid land which has been acquired for the purpose of National Highway by the Land Acquisition Authority under the new Land Acquisition Act, i.e., The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
4.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: From perusal of the counter affidavit, filed by the respondents-State, it appears that several disputes have been referred for adjudication, but the dispute raised by this petitioner has not been referred for adjudication under the Land Acquisition Act.

5. In view of the above fact, the present writ petition is hereby, disposed of directing the respondents authority to refer the dispute, raised by the petitioner, to the appropriate forum, in accordance with law.
6. With the above direction, the the present writ petition is hereby, disposed of.

7. Pending interlocutory application, if any, stands disposed of.
(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Chandan/-
